ps1.5:99.5: Anattato manasikaroto katamo vimokkho adhimatto hoti?
ps1.5:100.1: Aniccato manasikaroto animitto vimokkho adhimatto hoti,
ps1.5:100.3: dukkhato manasikaroto appaṇihito vimokkho adhimatto hoti,
ps1.5:100.5: anattato manasikaroto suññato vimokkho adhimatto hoti,
ps1.5:101.9: ‘jhānaphassaṃ paṭhamaṃ phusati, pacchā nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ sacchikarotīti'
ps1.5:101.11: ‘dukkhā saṅkhārā sukho nirodho ti ñātaṃ hoti diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāyāti'
ps1.5:101.13: Ye hi keci nekkhammaṃ bhāvitā vā bhāventi vā bhāvissanti vā . . . pe . . .
ps1.5:101.14: sabbe te animittavimokkhassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena kāyasakkhī, suññatavimokkhassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.
ps1.5:102.4: ye hi keci dukkhaṃ parijānanti, samudayaṃ pajahanti, nirodhaṃ sacchikaronti, maggaṃ bhāventi; sabbe te animittavimokkhassa vasena saddhāvimuttā, appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena kāyasakkhī, suññatavimokkhassa vasena diṭṭhippattā.
ps1.5:103.5: Dukkhasaccaṃ pariññāpaṭivedhaṃ paṭivijjhati, samudayasaccaṃ pahānapaṭivedhaṃ paṭivijjhati,
ps1.5:103.9: imehi catūh' ākārehi saccāni paṭivijjhanto animittavimokkhassa vasena saddhāvimutto, appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena kāyasakkhī, suññatavimokkhassa vasena diṭṭhippatto.
ps1.5:104.5: Dukkhasaccaṃ pariññāpaṭivedhaṃ paṭivijjhati, samudayasaccaṃ pahānapaṭivedhaṃ paṭivijjhati . . . pe . . .
ps1.5:104.8: imehi navah' ākārehi saccāni paṭivijjhanto animittavimokkhassa vasena saddhāvimutto, appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena kāyasakkhī, suññatavimokkhassa vasena diṭṭhippatto. Paṭis_I,V.38:
ps1.5:105.1: Aniccato manasikaronto katame dhamme yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati?
ps1.5:105.3: Kathaṃ tadanvayena sabbe saṅkhārā aniccato sudiṭṭhā honti?
ps1.5:105.5: Dukkhato manasikaronto katame dhamme yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati?
ps1.5:105.7: Kathaṃ tadanvayena sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhato sudiṭṭhā honti?
ps1.5:105.9: Anattato manasikaronto katame dhamme yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati?
ps1.5:105.11: Kathaṃ tadanvayena sabbe saṅkhārā anattato sudiṭṭhā honti?
ps1.5:106.1: Aniccato manasikaronto nimittaṃ yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati.
ps1.5:106.4: Evaṃ tadanvayena sabbe saṅkhārā aniccato sudiṭṭhā honti.
ps1.5:106.6: Dukkhato manasikaronto pavattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati.
ps1.5:106.9: Evaṃ tadanvayena sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhato sudiṭṭhā honti.
ps1.5:106.11: Anattato manasikaronto nimittañ ca pavattañ ca yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati.
ps1.5:106.14: Evaṃ tadanvayena sabbe saṅkhārā anattato sudiṭṭhā honti.
ps1.5:107.1: Yañ ca yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ yañ ca sammādassanaṃ yā ca kaṅkhāvitaraṇā, ime dhammā nānatthā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca? Udāhu ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānan ti?
ps1.5:107.2: Yañ ca yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ yañ ca sammādassanaṃ yā ca kaṅkhāvitaraṇā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānaṃ. Paṭis_I,V.39:
ps1.5:108.6: Anattato manasikaroto nimittañ ca pavattañ ca bhayato upaṭṭhāti.
ps1.5:109.1: Yā ca bhayatupaṭṭhāne paññā yañ ca ādīnave ñāṇaṃ yā ca nibbidā, ime dhammā nānatthā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca? Udāhu ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānan ti?
ps1.5:109.2: Yā ca bhayatupaṭṭhāne paññā yañ ca ādīnave ñāṇaṃ yā ca nibbidā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānaṃ.
ps1.5:110.1: Yā ca anattānupassanā yā ca suññatānupassanā, ime dhammā nānatthā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca? Udāhu ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānan ti?
ps1.5:110.2: Yā ca anattānupassanā yā ca suññatānupassanā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānaṃ. Paṭis_I,V.40:
ps1.5:111.1: Aniccato manasikaroto kiṃ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṃ uppajjati?
ps1.5:111.2: Dukkhato manasikaroto kiṃ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṃ uppajjati?
ps1.5:111.3: Anattato manasikaroto kiṃ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṃ uppajjati?
ps1.5:111.4: Aniccato manasikaroto nimittaṃ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
ps1.5:111.5: Dukkhato manasikaroto pavattaṃ paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
ps1.5:111.6: Anattato manasikaroto nimittañ ca pavattañ ca paṭisaṅkhā ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
ps1.5:112.1: Yā ca muñcitūkamyatā yā ca paṭisaṅkhānupassanā yā ca saṅkhārūpekkhā, ime dhammā nānatthā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca? Udāhu ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānan ti?
ps1.5:112.2: Yā ca muñcitūkamyatā yā ca paṭisaṅkhānupassanā yā ca saṅkhārūpekkhā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānaṃ.
ps1.5:113.1: Aniccato manasikaroto kuto cittaṃ vuṭṭhāti? Kattha cittaṃ pakkhandati?
ps1.5:113.2: Dukkhato manasikaroto kuto cittaṃ vuṭṭhāti? Kattha cittaṃ pakkhandati?
ps1.5:113.3: Anattato manasikaroto kuto cittaṃ vuṭṭhāti? Kattha cittaṃ pakkhandati?
ps1.5:113.4: Aniccato manasikaroto nimittā cittaṃ vuṭṭhāti, animitte cittaṃ pakkhandati.
ps1.5:113.5: Dukkhato manasikaroto pavattā cittaṃ vuṭṭhāti, appavatte cittaṃ pakkhandati.
ps1.5:113.6: Anattato manasikaroto nimittā ca pavattā ca cittaṃ vuṭṭhāti, animitte appavatte nirodhanibbānadhātuyā cittaṃ pakkhandati.
ps1.5:114.1: Yā ca bahiddhāvuṭṭhānavivaṭṭane paññā ye ca gotrabhūdhammā, ime dhammā nānatthā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca? Udāhu ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānan ti?
ps1.5:114.2: Yā ca bahiddhāvuṭṭhānavivaṭṭane paññā ye ca gotrabhūdhammā, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānaṃ.
ps1.5:116.1: Yā ca dubhatovuṭṭhānavivaṭṭane paññā yañ ca magge ñāṇaṃ, ime dhammā nānatthā c' eva nānābyañjanā ca? Udāhu ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānan ti?
ps1.5:116.2: Yā ca dubhatovuṭṭhānavivaṭṭane paññā yañ ca magge ñāṇaṃ, ime dhammā ekatthā, byañjanam eva nānaṃ.
ps1.5:117.1: Paṭis_I,V.41: Katih' ākārehi tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:117.2: Katih' ākārehi tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:117.3: Catūh' ākārehi tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:117.4: Sattah' ākārehi tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:118.1: Katamehi catūh' ākārehi tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:118.3: Kathaṃ ādhipateyyaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:118.4: Aniccato manasikaroto animitto vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, dukkhato manasikaroto appaṇihito vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti, anattato manasikaroto suññato vimokkho ādhipateyyo hoti.
ps1.5:118.5: Evaṃ ādhipateyyaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:119.1: Kathaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:119.2: Aniccato manasikaronto animittavimokkhassa vasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, dukkhato manasikaronto appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, anattato manasikaronto suññatavimokkhassa vasena cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
ps1.5:119.3: Evaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:120.1: Kathaṃ abhinīhāraṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:120.2: Aniccato manasikaronto animittavimokkhassa vasena cittaṃ abhinīharati, dukkhato manasikaronto appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena cittaṃ abhinīharati, anattato manasikaronto suññatavimokkhassa vasena cittaṃ abhinīharati.
ps1.5:120.3: Evaṃ abhinīhāraṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:121.1: Kathaṃ niyyānaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:121.2: Aniccato manasikaronto animittavimokkhassa vasena nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ niyyāti, dukkhato manasikaronto appaṇihitavimokkhassa vasena nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ niyyāti, anattato manasikaronto suññatavimokkhassa vasena nirodhaṃ nibbānaṃ niyyāti.
ps1.5:121.3: Evaṃ niyyānaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:121.4: Imehi catūh' ākārehi tayo vimokkhā nānākhaṇe honti. Paṭis_I,V.42:
ps1.5:122.1: Katamehi sattah' ākārehi tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:122.2: Samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena.
ps1.5:122.3: Kathaṃ samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti?
ps1.5:122.12: Evaṃ samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:123.9: Evaṃ samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:124.9: Evaṃ samodhānaṭṭhena adhigamanaṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena paṭivedhaṭṭhena sacchikiriyaṭṭhena phassanaṭṭhena abhisamayaṭṭhena tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti.
ps1.5:124.10: Imehi sattah' ākārehi tayo vimokkhā ekakkhaṇe honti. Paṭis_I,V.43:
ps1.5:125.1: Atthi vimokkho, atthi mukhaṃ, atthi vimokkhamukhaṃ, atthi vimokkhapaccanīkaṃ, atthi vimokkhānulomaṃ, atthi vimokkhavivaṭṭanā, atthi vimokkhabhāvanā, atthi vimokkhapaṭippassaddhi.
ps1.5:126.2: Suññato vimokkho, animitto vimokkho, appaṇihito vimokkho.
ps1.5:131.3: ‘rūpe animittānupassanāñāṇaṃ nimittato muccatīti' appaṇihito vimokkho, ‘rūpe appaṇihitānupassanāñāṇaṃ sabbapaṇidhīhi muccatīti'
ps1.5:131.14: ‘jarāmaraṇe animittānupassanāñāṇaṃ nimittato muccatīti' appaṇihito vimokkho, ‘jarāmaraṇe appaṇihitānupassanāñāṇaṃ sabbapaṇidhīhi muccatīti'
ps1.5:132.2: Ye tattha jātā anavajjā kusalā bodhipakkhiyā dhammā. Idaṃ mukhaṃ.
ps1.5:133.2: Yaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ ārammaṇaṃ nirodho nibbānaṃ.
ps1.5:134.2: Tīṇi akusalamūlāni vimokkhapaccanīkāni, tīṇi duccaritāni vimokkhapaccanīkāni, sabbe pi akusalā dhammā vimokkhapaccanīkā. Idaṃ vimokkhapaccanīkaṃ.
ps1.5:135.2: Tīṇi kusalamūlāni vimokkhānulomāni, tīṇi sucaritāni vimokkhānulomāni, sabbe pi kusalā dhammā vimokkhānulomā. Idaṃ vimokkhānulomaṃ. Paṭis_I,V.47:
ps1.5:136.2: Saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo vimokkhavivaṭṭo saccavivaṭṭo.
ps1.5:137.1: Yattha saññāvivaṭṭo tattha cetovivaṭṭo, yattha cetovivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo; yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo tattha cittavivaṭṭo, yattha cittavivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo;
ps1.5:137.2: yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo tattha ñāṇavivaṭṭo, yattha ñāṇavivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo;
ps1.5:137.3: yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo tattha vimokkhavivaṭṭo, yattha vimokkhavivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo;
ps1.5:137.4: yattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo vimokkhavivaṭṭo tattha saccavivaṭṭo, yattha saccavivaṭṭo tattha saññāvivaṭṭo cetovivaṭṭo cittavivaṭṭo ñāṇavivaṭṭo vimokkhavivaṭṭo.
ps1.5:138.2: Paṭhamassa jhānassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ, dutiyassa jhānassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ, tatiyassa jhānassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ, catutthassa jhānassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ, ākāsānañcāyatanasamāpattiyā āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ, viññāṇañcāyatanasamāpattiyā . . . pe . . .
ps1.5:138.4: nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ, sotāpattimaggassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ, sakadāgāmimaggassa . . . pe . . . anāgāmimaggassa . . . pe . . . Arahattamaggassa āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammaṃ. Ayaṃ vimokkhabhāvanā.
ps1.5:139.2: Paṭhamassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā, dutiyassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā, tatiyassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā,
ps1.5:139.3: catutthassa jhānassa paṭilābho vā vipāko vā,
ps1.5:139.7: nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattiyā paṭilābho vā vipāko vā, sotāpattimaggassa sotāpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmimaggassa sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmimaggassa anāgāmiphalaṃ, Arahattamaggassa Arahattaphalaṃ. Ayaṃ vimokkhapaṭippassaddhīti.
